name: radio-cards
purpose: Horizontal grid of selectable cards for mutually exclusive choices (plans, roles, feature tiers). Each option shows label, optional icon and description, with optional trailing content via the `tag` slot. Migrated from the legacy `radio-cards` core component into the webkit inputs layer.
useWhen: One choice among a few options where each option needs a label plus an optional icon or one-line description: usage intent, role, plan tier.
Options laid out side by side as cards that wrap onto new rows, bound to one `v-model` value for the whole group.
A card needs small trailing content under its text, such as a price or a "Recommended" tag, through the `tag` slot.
avoidWhen: You place each card-style radio by hand, or the choice must submit through a native form `name` → use `field` choice cards (`Field.Label` wrapping a horizontal `Field` with a `radio-button`).
The options don't need card weight and read fine as inline rows → use horizontal `field`s with a `radio-button`.
There are more options than fit in a row or two, or the choice sits in a compact form → use `select` inside a `field`.
More than one option can be picked → use `field` choice cards with a `checkbox`.
related: field` — a `Field.Label` choice card is a single card-style radio (or checkbox) with title and description; compose several by hand with a shared `name`, or use a horizontal `Field` for an inline labelled row.
select` — dropdown for long option lists.
onboarding-form` — uses this component for its usage-intent question.
bestPractices: Give every item a unique `value`; it is both the `v-model` payload and the render key.

Name the group by passing `aria-labelledby` or `aria-label` on the component: it renders a `role="radiogroup"` with no visible label of its own. Set an item's `ariaLabel` when its `label` alone is ambiguous.
disabled` applies to the whole group; there is no per-item disabled state, so leave unavailable options out of `items`.
Use the `tag` slot for trailing content. The `default` slot replaces the whole card body (icon, label, description and `tag`), so use it only when the card needs a different layout.
Arrow keys move and select in one step, as in any radio group, so `update:modelValue` fires while a keyboard user browses. Don't trigger navigation or requests on every change.

props.name: items
props.doc: Options rendered as selectable cards; each entry must include `value` and `label`.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables all options and applies disabled tokens.

events.name: update:modelValue
events.notes: v-model when the user selects an option.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: Overrides the entire card body for an option.

slots.name: tag
slots.notes: Trailing content below label/description (e.g. plan badge).

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import RadioCards from '@aziontech/webkit/radio-cards'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const items = [
    {
      value: 'option1',
      icon: 'pi pi-check',
      label: 'Option One',
      description: 'First option description'
    },
    {
      value: 'option2',
      icon: 'pi pi-times',
      label: 'Option Two',
      description: 'Second option description'
    },
    {
      value: 'option3',
      icon: 'pi pi-star',
      label: 'Option Three',
      description: 'Third option description'
    }
  ]
  const selected = ref('option1')
</script>

<template>
  <RadioCards
    v-model="selected"
    :items="items"
  />
</template>

examples.name: WithTag
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import RadioCards from '@aziontech/webkit/radio-cards'
  import Tag from '@aziontech/webkit/tag'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const items = [
    {
      value: 'hobby',
      icon: 'pi pi-sparkles',
      label: 'Hobby',
      description: 'For learning and small personal projects.',
      ariaLabel: 'Hobby plan',
      tag: 'Hobby Plan'
    },
    {
      value: 'pro',
      icon: 'pi pi-chart-line',
      label: 'Pro',
      description: 'For professional or commercial applications.',
      ariaLabel: 'Pro plan',
      tag: 'Pro Plan'
    },
    {
      value: 'scale',
      icon: 'pi pi-file-check',
      label: 'Scale',
      description: 'For businesses requiring advanced security and compliance.',
      ariaLabel: 'Scale plan',
      tag: 'Scale Plan'
    }
  ]
  const selected = ref('hobby')
</script>

<template>
  <RadioCards
    v-model="selected"
    :items="items"
  >
    <template #tag="{ item }">
      <Tag
        :label="item.tag"
        severity="info"
      />
    </template>
  </RadioCards>
</template>
